about: Become the terrifying force which everything fears but nothing can escape. Awakened by the End of Days, Death, the most feared of the legendary Four Horsemen embarks on a quest to redeem his brother's name.
Along the way, the Horseman discovers that an ancient grudge may threaten all of Creation. Death lives!

Deathinitive Edition Features: Darksiders 2 with all DLC included and integrated into the game which offers a total playtime of more than 30 hours Reworked and tuned game balancing and loot distribution Improved Graphic Render Engine for higher…
Epic Universe: Unlike anything the player has seen before, delivered in the unique style of Joe Mad.
Player Choice & Customization: Customize your experience with varied armor sets, weapons, and Skill Trees allowing players to create their own Death.
Replay-ability:  Explore a vast open world,  complete dozens of side quests and customize your Death with a full leveling system, Skill Trees and endless equipment combinations.
